meta.name: Obsidian Ward-Breakers Seal
meta.description: A rare subterranean pocket mine of The Sovereign Ward-Breakers of the Obsidian Seal. Siege geomancers swore to crack the 1% strict-locked Obsidian Hazard seals here. Rich in wick and pewter veins, this geode chamber straddles the active quarry frontier.
